generations.name: Third generation (C178, MMA)
generations.notes: Electric CLA on the MMA platform, 800 V, 85 kWh usable pack, up to 320 kW DC (CLA 250+ and CLA 350 4MATIC). EPA "(R22)" is a wheel/tire option. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_CLA
